A '''sector branch''' was the basic division of [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]]. Each [[Sector/Legends|sector]] within the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] had a branch, and each branch had a pool of experts from which the [[Sedition]] and [[Crisis]] branches drew operatives from in times of need depending on the situation.<ref name="ISB">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref>
